images.title: Rectangle from two squares
images.purpose: Show rectangle ACDF made of two equal squares of side 4 cm, so it is 8 cm by 4 cm.
images.composition: One wide rectangle centred, split by one vertical line into two equal squares, with a bracket along the bottom.
images.exact_structure: One rectangle ACDF, 8 units wide and 4 units tall, outline teal #0072B2, split by one grey #6B7280 vertical line into two exactly equal squares. Bottom edge points: A left, B middle on the line, C right. Top points: F left, D right. Left square shaded light teal, right square plain. Bottom bracket along AC labelled 8 cm, left side labelled 4 cm. Exactly 1 rectangle, 2 squares, 1 splitting line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
squares of unequal size, or AC labelled 4 cm
images.takeaway: Two squares of side 4 cm make a rectangle 8 cm by 4 cm.
images.description: Rectangle 8 cm by 4 cm split in the middle into two equal squares of side 4 cm.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say the side of each square and then add them to get AC.

image_decisions.why: One clean geometry picture carries the single idea of this video.
